name: TfL Reliability Intelligence Platform
description: A live data platform that turns short-lived status updates across five TfL rail and tram modes into tested, coverage-aware reliability analytics.
features: Five-minute idempotent ingestion from the TfL Unified API
Tube, Elizabeth line, DLR, London Overground and Tram coverage
Postgres raw system of record with retained payloads and pipeline-run metadata
dbt staging, intermediate, fact, dimension and reliability mart layers
Coverage-aware observed uptime and inferred disruption episodes
Mode comparison, status mix, coverage scatter and hourly disruption heatmap
Read-only Metabase BI workspace backed by atomically published dbt marts
Read-only FastAPI contract with a responsive operational dashboard
Airflow orchestration, data-quality gates, CI/CD and recoverable backups
overview: TfL Intel captures changing line-status snapshots and turns them into an auditable history. It separates operational storage from analytical serving and reports collection coverage alongside every reliability metric.
full_description:
The project demonstrates a complete data-engineering lifecycle: retried ingestion, deterministic identifiers, idempotent loading, raw evidence retention, tested dbt models, scheduled orchestration, a typed API, a live product dashboard and a Metabase BI workspace.

Postgres is the durable source of truth. Airflow snapshots it into DuckDB, dbt publishes tested marts, and FastAPI serves those marts without receiving operational database credentials. Validated marts are separately published for Metabase through a schema-restricted reader. View the source on GitHub.
challenges: A missing API observation cannot safely be interpreted as good service. The model therefore calculates uptime only from observed buckets and publishes a separate coverage percentage and quality label.
outcome: A deployable single-host platform that makes mode comparisons, status mix, hourly patterns, disruption history, observed uptime and analytical confidence visible through one public interface.
tech_stack: Python 3.13, httpx, Pydantic, psycopg, PostgreSQL 16, DuckDB, dbt-duckdb, Apache Airflow, FastAPI, Metabase, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions and Nginx Proxy Manager.
